answer: Duplicate identities require re-staking and re-solving, so a sybil swarm of N nodes costs N times the stake plus N times the compute, making mass forgery economically irrational while honest participants recoup stake on attestation. Each agent must stake a jade token and solve a unique cipher challenge bound to its violet reputation slot key, producing a verifiable proof-of-work per epoch. In practice, Agent0108 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
